quality.review_scope: Optimized 3:7 n-octylamine/oleylamine CdTe platelets at 100 °C for 16 h, two precursor stock preparations, aliquot workup, primary product observations and selected cited figures. Other branches remain pending.
missing_fields: Centrifuge speed/time, final chloroform volume, exact room temperature and storage duration are not reported.
Product yield, exact stock storage times, aliquot centrifugation conditions, grid preparation, absorption dilution and optical path length.
conflicts: The stock contains excess parent phosphine. Primary-amine reaction medium likely forms transaminated precursors; no exact in-solution species is established.
requested_tasks: Independent full comparison of this core-scoped contribution; pending variants are not reviewed recipes.
